about: Local governments whose public meeting agendas Civic Accord reads automatically. Each entry is one government. Agendas come straight from the government's own public agenda system; nothing is written or reworded. Add a government by adding one entry with a source for each field. The first two pilots were chosen because their agenda systems offer public data with no key needed, and because they test a county (Maui County, Hawaiʻi) and a city (Oakland, California).

feeds.name: Maui County Council
feeds.note: Council, committee, and other public meetings. Each meeting page and agenda says how to comment.
